name: Chiori
notes: A Geo sub-DPS whose Skill carries the damage (Tamoto 82% ATK + 103% DEF at level 1; her Skill's Hiyoku 256% ATK + 320% DEF), so DEF is the scaling stat. Both sources agree on the Skill first, the weapon top three (Uraku Misugiri, Peak Patrol Song, Primordial Jade Cutter) and a DEF% Sands, with a crit Circlet. They name the same two sets in different orders (KQM 4pc Golden Troupe for her usual off-field play; Game8 4pc Husk first); the card follows KQM. Goals: DEF 2,000-2,400, CR 70-80% and CD 160% or above are Game8's (upper ends). KQM's ER table runs from 110% to 290% by team; 190% is the top of its Navia, two-Skills row, a usual team. No DMG goal is set, since the Goblet may be DEF% or Geo DMG%.
